1.text: In tha second year of Darius tha king, in tha sixth month, in tha first day of tha month, came tha word of tha LORD by Haggai tha prophet 2 Zerubbabel tha son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, N 2 Joshua tha son of Josedech, tha high priest, sayin,
Like dis speaks tha LORD of hosts, sayin, dis people say, tha time is not come, tha time dat tha LORD’s house should be built.
Then came tha word of tha LORD by Haggai tha prophet, sayin,
Is it time 4 u, O y’all, 2 live in ur cieled houses, N dis house lie waste?
Now therefore like dis says tha LORD of hosts; Consider ur ways.

y’all have sown much, N bring in little; y’all eat, but y’all have not enough; y’all drink, but y’all r not filled wit drink; y’all clothe u, but there is none warm; N he dat earneth wages earneth wages 2 put it in2 a bag wit holes.
Like dis says tha LORD of hosts; Consider ur ways.
Go up 2 tha mountain, N bring wood, N build tha house; N I will take pleasure in it, N I will be glorified, says tha LORD.

y’all looked 4 much, N, look, it came 2 little; N when y’all brought it home, I did blow upon it. Why? says tha LORD of hosts. Because of mine house dat is waste, N y’all run every man 2 his own house.
Therefore tha heaven over u is stayed from dew, N tha earth is stayed from her fruit.

N I called 4 a drought upon tha land, N upon tha mountains, N upon tha corn, N upon tha new wine, N upon tha oil, N upon dat which tha ground brings forth, N upon men, N upon cattle, N upon all tha labour of tha hands.

Then Zerubbabel tha son of Shealtiel, N Joshua tha son of Josedech, tha high priest, wit all tha remnant of tha people, obeyed tha voice of tha LORD their God, N tha words of Haggai tha prophet, as tha LORD their God had sent him, N tha people did fear before tha LORD.
Then spoke Haggai tha LORD’s messenger in tha LORD’s message 2 tha people, sayin, I am wit u, says tha LORD.

N tha LORD stirred up tha spirit of Zerubbabel tha son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, N tha spirit of Joshua tha son of Josedech, tha high priest, N tha spirit of all tha remnant of tha people; N dey came N did work in tha house of tha LORD of hosts, their God,
In tha four N twentieth day of tha sixth month, in tha second year of Darius tha king.

2.text: In tha seventh month, in tha one N twentieth day of tha month, came tha word of tha LORD by tha prophet Haggai, sayin,
Speak now 2 Zerubbabel tha son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, N 2 Joshua tha son of Josedech, tha high priest, N 2 tha residue of tha people, sayin,
Who is left among u dat saw dis house in her first glory? N how do y’all see it now? is it not in ur eyes in comparison of it as nothing?

Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, says tha LORD; N be strong, O Joshua, son of Josedech, tha high priest; N be strong, all y’all people of tha land, says tha LORD, N work: 4 I am wit u, says tha LORD of hosts:
According 2 tha word dat I covenanted wit u when y’all came out of Egypt, so my spirit remains among u: fear y’all not.
4 like dis says tha LORD of hosts; Yet once, it is a little while, N I will shake tha heavenz, N tha earth, N tha sea, N tha dry land;
N I will shake all nations, N tha desire of all nations shall come: N I will fill dis house wit glory, says tha LORD of hosts.
Tha silver is mine, N tha gold is mine, says tha LORD of hosts.
Tha glory of dis latter house shall be greater than of tha former, says tha LORD of hosts: N in dis place will I give peace, says tha LORD of hosts.
In tha four N twentieth day of tha ninth month, in tha second year of Darius, came tha word of tha LORD by Haggai tha prophet, sayin,
Like dis says tha LORD of hosts; Ask now tha priests concerning tha law, sayin,
If one bear holy flesh in tha skirt of his garment, N wit his skirt do touch bread, or pottage, or wine, or oil, or any food, shall it be holy? N tha priests answered, No.
Then said Haggai, If one dat is unclean by a dead body touch any of dese, shall it be unclean? N tha priests answered, It shall be unclean.
Then answered Haggai, N said, So is dis people, N so is dis nation before me, says tha LORD; N so is every work of their hands; N dat which dey offer there is unclean.
N now, I pray u, consider from dis day N upward, from before a stone was laid upon a stone in tha temple of tha LORD:
Since dose days were, when one came 2 an heap of twenty measures, there were but ten: when one came 2 tha pressfat 4 2 draw out fifty vessels out of tha press, there were but twenty.
I struck u wit blasting N wit mildew N wit hail in all tha labours of ur hands; yet y’all turned not 2 me, says tha LORD.
Consider now from dis day N upward, from tha four N twentieth day of tha ninth month, even from tha day dat tha foundation of tha LORD’s temple was laid, consider it.
Is tha seed yet in tha barn? yeah, as yet tha vine, N tha fig tree, N tha pomegranate, N tha olive tree, has not brought forth: from dis day will I bless u.
N again tha word of tha LORD came 2 Haggai in tha four N twentieth day of tha month, sayin,
Speak 2 Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, sayin, I will shake tha heavenz N tha earth;

N I will overthrow tha throne of kingdoms, N I will destroy tha strength of tha kingdoms of tha heathen; N I will overthrow tha chariots, N dose dat ride in ’em; N tha horses N their riders shall come down, every one by tha sword of his brother.
In dat day, says tha LORD of hosts, will I take u, O Zerubbabel, my servant, tha son of Shealtiel, says tha LORD, N will make u as a signet: 4 I have chosen u, says tha LORD of hosts.
